schema.name: DatadogSecurityLogs_CL
schema.description: Datadog security signals collected from the Security Monitoring API

columns.name: EventId
columns.description: Unique identifier of the Datadog security signal

columns.name: EventType
columns.description: Resource type of the event (always 'signal')

columns.name: Attributes
columns.description: Full attributes object of the Datadog security signal

columns.name: SignalDetails
columns.description: Detection and workflow details associated with the security signal

columns.name: SignalId
columns.description: Datadog identifier stored in the signal attributes

columns.name: SignalVersion
columns.description: Version of the Datadog security signal

columns.name: SignalTitle
columns.description: Title of the security signal

columns.name: Message
columns.description: Security signal message

columns.name: Host
columns.description: Host associated with the security signal

columns.name: Service
columns.description: Services associated with the security signal

columns.name: Status
columns.description: Severity status of the security signal

columns.name: Severity
columns.description: Numeric severity of the security signal

columns.name: Tags
columns.description: Tags associated with the security signal

columns.name: TagDetails
columns.description: Structured tag values associated with the security signal

columns.name: EventTimestamp
columns.description: Timestamp reported by Datadog for the security signal

columns.name: DiscoveryTimestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when Datadog discovered the security signal

columns.name: TriggeringLogTimestamp
columns.description: Timestamp of the log that triggered the security signal

columns.name: EventTrackerId
columns.description: Datadog event tracker identifier

columns.name: GroupByValuesHash
columns.description: Hash of the values used to group the security signal

columns.name: ReducerSignalId
columns.description: Identifier of the reduced security signal

columns.name: SourceFragmentId
columns.description: Identifier of the source fragment

columns.name: TriggeringLogId
columns.description: Identifier of the log that triggered the security signal

columns.name: IngestSizeInBytes
columns.description: Size of the ingested security signal in bytes

columns.name: Source
columns.description: Source that produced the security signal

columns.name: EventSource
columns.description: Event sources represented in the security signal

columns.name: EventName
columns.description: Event names represented in the security signal

columns.name: Entities
columns.description: Entities associated with the security signal

columns.name: CloudEntities
columns.description: Cloud entities associated with the security signal

columns.name: Datasets
columns.description: Datasets used to generate the security signal

columns.name: Ocsf
columns.description: Open Cybersecurity Schema Framework data

columns.name: OcsfEntities
columns.description: OCSF-normalized entities associated with the security signal

columns.name: OcsfCategory
columns.description: OCSF event categories represented in the signal

columns.name: OcsfClass
columns.description: OCSF event classes represented in the signal

columns.name: OcsfSeverity
columns.description: OCSF severity values represented in the signal

columns.name: OcsfStatus
columns.description: OCSF status values represented in the signal

columns.name: OcsfCloudProvider
columns.description: Cloud provider identified by OCSF

columns.name: OcsfCloudRegion
columns.description: Cloud regions identified by OCSF

columns.name: OcsfActorUserId
columns.description: Actor user identifiers identified by OCSF

columns.name: OcsfSourceIp
columns.description: Source IP addresses identified by OCSF

columns.name: UserIdentity
columns.description: Source identity details associated with the signal

columns.name: UserIdentityType
columns.description: Type of source identity associated with the signal

columns.name: UserIdentityArn
columns.description: AWS ARNs associated with the source identity

columns.name: UserIdentityAccountId
columns.description: AWS account identifiers associated with the source identity

columns.name: UserIdentityAccessKeyId
columns.description: AWS access key identifiers associated with the source identity

columns.name: UserDetails
columns.description: Normalized user details associated with the signal

columns.name: UserId
columns.description: User identifiers associated with the signal

columns.name: UserName
columns.description: User names associated with the signal

columns.name: Workflow
columns.description: Detection workflow and triage details

columns.name: WorkflowState
columns.description: Current triage state of the security signal

columns.name: EventsMatched
columns.description: Number of events matched by the detection rule

columns.name: RuleId
columns.description: Identifier of the detection rule

columns.name: RuleName
columns.description: Name of the detection rule

columns.name: RuleType
columns.description: Type of the detection rule

columns.name: DetectionMethod
columns.description: Detection method used by the rule

columns.name: WorkflowFirstSeen
columns.description: Timestamp when the matching activity was first seen

columns.name: WorkflowLastSeen
columns.description: Timestamp when the matching activity was last seen

columns.name: TriggeringRuleCase
columns.description: Triggering rule case details

columns.name: TriggerCondition
columns.description: Condition that triggered the rule case

columns.name: TriggerCaseName
columns.description: Name of the rule case that triggered the signal

columns.name: TriggerCaseStatus
columns.description: Status of the rule case that triggered the signal

columns.name: RelatedQuery
columns.description: Query associated with the security signal

columns.name: SignalCasesHistory
columns.description: History of rule cases associated with the signal

columns.name: Queries
columns.description: Queries evaluated for the security signal

columns.name: Samples
columns.description: Sample events associated with the security signal

columns.name: NetworkDetails
columns.description: Network details associated with the security signal

columns.name: HttpDetails
columns.description: HTTP details associated with the security signal
